claim.claim-text: 1. A drug delivery ocular implant, comprising:

2. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein the retention means is a protrusion (359) is provided at a second end of the outer shell (54), the implant further comprising a cap (53a) and wherein the region of drug release (56) extends through the cap (53a).
3. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 2, wherein the cap (53a) is a crimp cap.
4. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 2, wherein the outer shell (54) comprises a first material and the cap (53a) comprises a second material different than the first material.
5. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 2, wherein the cap (53a) fits over the first end of the outer shell (54).
6. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein the retention means is a retention protrusion (359) extending from a second end of the outer shell (54).
7. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, further comprising the drug (62) disposed within the interior lumen (58) of the outer shell (54).
8. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein a rate of drug release from the implant is at least partially defined by the permeable or semi-permeable material.
9. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 8, wherein the rate of drug release is defined by a thickness of the permeable or semi-permeable material.
10. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 8, wherein the rate of drug release is defined by a permeability of the permeable or semi-permeable material.
11. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein the permeable or semi-permeable material comprises ethyl vinyl acetate (EVA).
12. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein the retention means is a retention protrusion (359) comprising a sharpened end.

13. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein the retention means is a retention protrusion (359) comprising one or more of ridges, claws, threads, flexible ribs, rivetlike shapes, flexible barbs, and barbed tips.

14. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein the outer shell (54) is formed from one or more of nitinol, polyvinyl alcohol, polyvinyl pyrolidone, polyurethane, ethyl vinyl acetate (EVA), polyolefin, a silicone elastomer, a silicone-modified polyether urethane, polypropylene, titanium, gold, silver, platinum, and ceramic.

15. The drug delivery ocular implant of Claim 1, wherein the implant further comprises a shunt configured to transport fluid from an anterior chamber to a physiologic outflow space to reduce intraocular pressure.
